note: SW-27 supported inference profiles. A profile is QUALIFIED on a machine only by an end-to-end measurement through the product (python -m sovereign_product.qualification run/derive/apply); until then it is reported UNQUALIFIED. A configuration above a measured envelope is REJECTED (jobs refused, health degraded). SLOs are the targets a ladder step must meet to count as qualified.
